summary: Miller-Meeks called Israel 'our greatest ally' in an October 2023 resolution, voted yes on $1 billion for Iron Dome in 2021 and spoke on the House floor in support, and posted 'We stand with Israel' in July 2024. She voted Yea on H.R. 6090 and sponsored successor H.R. 1007, both embedding the IHRA definition in Title VI education enforcement. A super PAC that received United Democracy Project funding, 314 Action Fund, spent over $1 million against her this cycle.
